{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Talos|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Talos''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Density}} II, {{MCW|Knockback}} II and {{MCW|Punch}} II. It is crafted from seven {{MCW|Block of Iron|blocks of iron}} and a [[Steel Alloy]], and has rare rarity.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/density_knockback_punch.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Talos" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Talos is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Density applies to maces, Knockback to melee weapons and Punch to bows. Knockback II and Punch II are the vanilla maximums.

== Trivia ==
* Talos is the bronze giant of Greek myth who guarded Crete, hence the metal-heavy recipe.
